This '''T-series tactical droid''' was deployed alongside a second tactical droid on a [[Battlesphere/Legends|Battlesphere]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] gave orders to [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1 Battle Droids]] during [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano's]] fight with [[EG-07]]. Both tactical droids were destroyed by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].
